content: “Pi mandashuptiquim caycunata ruranqui” nir Jesusta tapupäcungan

Juc junag Jesús Diospa wayin puncuchru yachrayächiptinmi, nätan salvacurcänanpag ali willapata musyayächiptinmi chrarärira sacerdöticunapa mandagnincuna, Moisés isquirbinganpita yachrachigcuna, alinninpag ricasha chacha runacunawan.
Chaychrümi Jesusta tapupäcura cay nir: “¿Pi nishuptiquitag rurayanqui caycunata u pitag cachraramushunqui cayta ruranaypag?”
Nipäcuptinmi Jesusga nira: “Nogas tapuyärishay juclaylata.
¿Pitag cachramura Juanta runacunata bautizänanpag, Dioschu u runacunachu? Mä nipäcamä”.
Niruptinga quiquincamam tapunacurcara cay nir: “¿Ima nishuntag? ‘Diosmi cachramura’ nirushaga, ‘¿Imanirtag mana chrasquicurcaraychu?’ nimäshunchri.
Nätan ‘Runacunam cachramura’ nirushaga, lapan runachr chapiypa wanurachimäshun. Nätan lapan runas musyapäcuraga Juan Diospa willacugnin cangantam”.
Chaypitam Jesusta nipäcura: “Manam musyapäcüchu Juanta pi cachramungantas”.
Nipäcuptin Jesusga “Chauraga manam nogasi nipäcushaychu, pi cachramasha captin caycunata rurayangätas” nira.
Dios cachramungancunata wanuchipäcunganpita tantiachingan
Chaypita Jesusga galayura runacuna rimapaytam shumag tantiapäcunanpag cay nir: “Juc runam chracranman murura üvasta. Chaypitam ishcay quima runacunata arrendacurcur, aywacura caruta unaylapag.
Chauraga nä üvas palay wichan chraramuptinga chracrayog runaga cachrara juc uryag runantam arrindupita manamunanpag. Nätan chay chracra uryagcunaga magarcurmi jinalata gargarirärira.
Chaura chracrayog runaga yapaytan cachrara juc uryag runantatag. Paytasi ashlircurmi, jinaman magarcurmi jinalata gargapäcusha.
Chay chracrayog runaga yapaymi cachraratag juc runanta. Chaytasi alisca magarcurmi jitaripäcusha.
Chaura chay chracrayog runaga: ‘¿Imanäshagtag?’ Niyanganpitam cay nira: ‘Cananga cachrashag cuyay churïtam. Pay chraruptinga manchacuylapitas gorärimungapishchri’ nir.

Chaura churin cachranganta ricaparärirga chay uryagcunaga, rimanacarärinag cay nirmi: ‘¡Jay! Chracrayogpa churin aywayämun. Wacmi chrasquinga taytanpacagta lapan imantasi, antis wanurachishun noganchipag lapan imansi cananpag’.
Nirga chracrapita jorgorcurmi churintaga wanurärichira”. Chayta nircurga, chaychru cayagcunata Jesús tapura cay nirmi: “¿Imatarag ruranga paycunata chay chracrayog runa?
Aywarcamurchri wanuchinga chay juyu uryagcunata, nätan chracrantachr gorunga juc runacunata”. Chay nigta mayarärirga: “Ama Dios munachunchu chaynuy cananchita” nipäcuram.
Chaura Jesusga paycunata rircärircurmi nira: “¿Imaninantatag isquirbishacuna:

content.text: ‘Manam alichu cay rumi’ nir, wayi sharcachigcuna wicapapäcunganga

content: Nircurmi cay nirun: “Pi maysi chay ruminuysi cayagta mana chrasquicamagga, lutantam ruracuyan. Nätan chay ruminuysi cayag cutimuptin alisca cunchuchisham capäcunga”.

Chauraga sacerdöticunapa mandagnincunaga, jinaman Moisés isquirbinganpita yachrachigcunaga chayüram Jesús chariyta munapäcura “Noganchitam lutan uryagcuna nirga niramanchi” nir. Nätan mana charipäcurachu runacunata manchacurmi.
Romachru mandag César pägaypita Jesusta tapucurcangan

Chauraga chay ashiparcayag runacunam juc ishcay lutan runacunata yachrarcachir Jesusman cachrarärira. Paycunaga chrarärin alitucuyar lutanta rimachipäcunan raygom. Jinaman lutanta rimapacuruptin tenintiman aywachipäcunanpagmi.
Chay runacunaga cay nirmi tapurärin: “Yachrachig, musyarcayämi rimangaysi, yachrachingaysi ali canganta. Gamga yachrayächinqui lapan runacunatas razoncagtam, jinaman Dios ningannuylam.
Mä niyärimay: Cesarta patenti pägarcayangä ¿alichu cayan u manachu ali?”
Chaura lutan pinsiarcayanganta tantiarurmi, Jesusga nirun: “¿Imanirtag lutan rimachimayta munarcayanqui Cesarpita?
Mä ricachipäcamay golgueta”. Ricarärichiptinga nirunmi: “¿Pipa cärantag cayga? Jinaman ¿pipa jutintag caychru isquirbisha cayan?”
Chaura paycunaga nipäcuram: “Roma nacionchru mandag Cesarpam”. Chaura Jesusga nirunmi: “Cesarpa cagta, Cesarta gopäcuy, nätan Diospa cagta, Diosta gopäcuy”.
Nätan runacunapa naupanchru mana imanaypas lutan rimachiyta atiparga, pengacusham quëdarärin alita niruptin, jinaman upäläcayäriram.
“Wanushacunaga cawacämungam” nir, Jesús yachrachingan
Chaypitam juc ishcay saduceo nipäcungan runacunaga aywapäcura Jesusman. Saduceocunaga “Manam pisi wanushapita cawacämunchu” nipäcunanpag. Chaymi Jesusta tapupäcura cay nir:

“Tayta, Moisespa isquirbishan charapäcunganchrüga cay niyanmi: ‘Juc olgo, warminchru mana churin captilan wanuruptinga chay wanushapa wauguenmi viüdanwan casaracunga, nätan chaypa churin caruptinga difuntupa jutintam chay wamra apanga’ niyanmi”.
Nircurmi cay nipäcura: “Capäcura ganchris wauguecunam. Mayorcagmi casararcular wanurura manaragsi churin captilan.
Chauraga shulcancagmi casaracura chay viüdanwan. Paysi wanurura manarag churin captilanmi.
Chaynuytan chaypa mas shulcancagsi casaracurura chay viüdanwan. Chaynuylam casararärira lapansi. Jinaman ganchrisnintinmi wanurärira churiynagla.
Jina guepantaga warmis wanururam.
Chauraga wanushacuna cawacämuptinga, ¿mayganpa warminrag canga ganchrisnintinsi chay warmilawan casaracurayaptinga?”
Nipäcuptinmi Jesusga cay nira: “Cay pachachrümi olgos warmis casaracurcayanga.
Nätan jana pachata aywananpag cawacämugcunaga ni manatan casaracurcangasi ni casarapäcunanpagsi rimapäcungachu.
Wacchrüga capäcunga angelcunanuymi, jinaman Diospa castanman muyusham mana imaysi wanugpag nä cawacämusha capäcur.
Quiquin Moisespis musyachimanchim wanushapita cawacämuypitaga. Chay casha rupayagpita payga mayara cay nimugtam ‘Diosga Abrahampas Isaacpas Jacobpas Diosninmi’ nimugtam.
Chaura Diosga manam wanushacunapa Diosninchu, antis cawayagcunapa Diosninmi. Paypagga lapan wanushacunas cawayanmi”.
Chauraga Moisés isquirbinganpita chay juc ishcay yachrachigcuna nipäcuram: “Tayta, alitam nirunqui”.
Nircurga manam mastaga tapupayta almitipäcurachu.
Diospa castan canganta Jesús reguechicungan
Chaura Jesusga tapura cay nirmi: “¿Imanirtag nipäcunqui: ‘Cristoga Davidpa castanpitam canga’ nirga?
Davidga quiquinmi Salmos libruchru Cristopita cay nira:
Chaura Rey Davidga Cristota ‘Munayniyognï’ niyaptinga, ¿imanaypatag chaura Cristoga canga Davidpa castan aywamugga?”
Moisespa isquirbishan yachrachigcunapita Jesús rimangan
Nätan lapan runacunas mayarcayaptinmi Jesusga discïpuluncunata cay nira:

“Gamcunaga ashucurcanquim Moisespa isquirbishan yachrachigcunapita. Paycunaga munapäcun ura uracama jacupäcusha puriytam. Paycunaga munapäcun pläzacunachru alisca saludasha caytaran. Paycunaga munapäcun gotucurcänan wayichrüsi alinnin tayucunachru tayaytaran. Nätan micunanpagsi tayayta munapäcun naupa naupamanran.

Chaycunaga viüdacunapa wayinman yaycuyurmi imalancagtas suwacurcan, nätan lutan ruranganta mana pisi tantiananpagmi Diosta alisca unay yangala manacurcan. Paycunaga canga pipita maypitas mas cunchuchisham”.
